name: HP Business Nylon Carrying Case
description: HP Business Nylon Carrying Case is designed inside and out with features that will be appreciated by a mobile traveller. Made from durable nylon, the case offers a large top load compartment with plenty of room to organise materials, plus store business cards, cell phones and other supplies. It can carry a notebook up to 40.89 cm (16.1”) and also includes a neoprene pouch for a mini or thin-and-light notebook up to 30.73 cm (12.1”).

name: HP Professional Backpack Case

name: HP Business Nylon Backpack
description: HP Business Nylon Backpack offers a sturdy, all-purpose backpack for mobile professionals and students alike. Constructed from durable nylon, with extra padding in the back and shoulder straps, it is designed with comfort in mind. A foam padded handle also makes it easy to lift or carry. Easily transport a notebook up to 43.92 cm (17.3”), or store a mini or thin and light notebook up to 30.73 cm (12.1”) inside a neoprene built-in pocket.

name: HP Deluxe 4 Wheel Roller Case
description: The HP Deluxe 4 Wheel Roller is a durable nylon case designed to carry everything you need for an overnight trip. An outer compartment features divided sections to store important files and business essentials. The case’s main compartment includes padded pockets that can hold a laptop up to up to 43.94 diagonal centimeter (17.3”) in size, plus additional cables and cords. The third, oversized compartment provides plenty of room for a change of clothes, shoes and personal toiletries. A retractable handle locks in two convenient heights.

name: NVIDIA Quadro 6000 6.0GB Graphics Card
description: The NVIDIA Quadro® 6000, part of the newest NVIDIA Quadro® professional solutions, is a true technological breakthrough, delivering up to 5X faster performance across a broad range of design, animation and video applications.

name: HP Executive Tablet Pen
description: Touch, Write. Use it your way. Write messages and notes in your own handwriting directly on your HP tablet PC screen. Then save it—or convert it to typed text to use in other applications.

name: NVIDIA Quadro 4000 2.0GB Graphics Card
description: Accelerate your entire workflow with NVIDIA’s High End Quadro® 4000 graphics card: Up to 5X faster 3D application performance scaling over previous generation Quadro® FX3800; GPGPU applications run 8X faster on Quadro® GPUs compared to other processors Revolutionary Quadro® GPU architecture.

name: AMD FirePro V3900 1GB Graphics Card
description: Introducing the AMD FirePro V3900 professional graphics accelerator from AMD. With 1GB of fast DDR3 frame buffer memory, the V3900 is ideally suited for CAD/CAM and DCC (digital content creation) workflows that typically use small to medium sized datasets and require excellent 3D viewport performance.

name: HP Wireless Keyboard and Mouse
description: The HP Wireless Keyboard and Mouse places advanced functionality and ease of operation at your fingertips. Stop hiding wires and regain a clutter-free work space with a cordless keyboard, cordless laser mouse and USB wireless receiver in a single package—built with the environment in mind.

name: HP 14.0 Privacy Filter
description: No more need to worry about prying eyes. This unique HP built-to-fit solution ensures confidential business data, personal information and financial records are visible only to the person sat directly in front of the notebook display.

name: HP Docking Station Cable Lock
description: The HP Docking Station Cable Lock is dramatically simpler to use than previous locks and delivers enhanced security. The HP Docking Station Cable Lock gives you two locking options: lock the docking station only (which also prevents access to the advanced docking stations drive bay) or lock both the docking station and the notebook.

name: HP Slim BDXL Blu-Ray Drive
description: Quickly and easily back up your data and create and edit professional-quality HD video content with the HP Slim Blu-ray BDXL SATA Drive and integrated CyberLink Media Suite. Enjoy read-write capabilities with CDs, DVDs, and Blu-ray discs.

name: HP 15.6 Privacy Filter
description: Limit unwelcome “from the side” display viewing, especially when used in constrained or limited spaces with the HP Privacy Filter. The HP Privacy Filter narrows the viewing angle of your notebook display so that people on either side see a dark, blank screen.

name: HP Ultraslim Keyed Cable Lock
description: Secure your HP Ultrabook™ or laptop PC quickly and easily with the HP Ultraslim Keyed Cable Lock.

name: HP Mobile USB NLS DVD-RW Drive
description: The HP Mobile DVD/RW provides an external companion optical drive to accompany a notebook or mini that does not have an internal drive. The external drive provides CD/DVD support as well as read/write functionality. An AC adapter is included.

name: HP 12.5-inch Privacy Filter
description: HP Privacy Filters help you protect your onscreen data by concealing your notebook screen from viewing by passersby and people seated nearby. The filter diminishes the readability for anyone not seated directly in front of the notebook while maintaining the onscreen resolution for the individual user.

name: HP 500GB 7200rpm SATA SFF SED Hard Drive
description: Add a layer of security to your high-capacity workstation storage solution with the HP 500 GB SATA SED HDD, which includes self-encrypting drive (SED) technology that adds authentication parameters to your drive to help protect your data.

name: HP 160GB SATA Solid State Drive
description: Solid State Drives (SSDs) are fast becoming a real force with respect to storage in the computer industry. With no moving parts, storage is no longer bound by mechanical barriers to higher performance. HP SSDs for workstations offer overall performance typically beyond that of SAS 15k rpm HDDs (Hard Disk Drives).

name: HP 1TB SATA 6Gb/s 7200 Hard Drive
description: SATA 7200 rpm drives are our standard high bandwidth hard drive storage options; most workstation models are also available with high performance 10K rpm rotation speeds. Storage capabilities range up to a massive 2.0 TB.
